page.overview:
Who is Dantz?

If agrees, remarks that he is the answer to his prayers. He explains that he needs to hunt the in , since they are overpopulated and destroying the environment. He gives a time limit of one minute. Should accept this, wants to know if he can start hunting right away.

When asks if there is a trick, suggests using a strong so that he will only have to take one shot. He also advises sneaking up to without them noticing. If decides to head out, calls him a trooper and asserts that he is counting on him. Before the starts, says he will call for once the minute is up. When runs out of time, he will be transported back to .

If fails to get a single , refuses to give him any reward. He gives him one for getting one to three as thanks for doing his part. If he gets four to six deer, calls vicious and rewards him with a . For seven to nine , admits it is more than he thought would get and gives him a . is shocked if gets all 10 , saying there is such a thing as being too good at hunting and giving him a .

Like all residents of , will notice if speaks to him while carrying the . He recalls that used to carry a similar flame, and while he does not know why a stranger has it, he sends along anyway. Afterwards, he will encourage to continue on his delivery for .
